name: Independent quality control and PM10 forecasting
purpose: Reprocess original local concentrations without EEA validity flags or externally selected evaluation rows, then refit ANN, TCN and XGBoost.
data_origin: Original-value column extracted from the preserved local provenance archive. External matched measurements and validity fields are neither extracted nor read by this experiment.
source_preservation: Immutable extracted values and source hashes; no edits to the preceding experiment.
hard_rules: Reject nonfinite values, known sentinels and violations of elementary physical domains. Negative concentrations are excluded as a nonnegative modelling convention, not certified sensor invalidity.
PM10 or PM2.5 exactly zero for at least 24 consecutive hours: exclude from the 24th hour onward; do not retrospectively remove earlier hours.
At least three pollutants exactly zero for at least six consecutive hours, including a particulate pollutant: exclude affected zero values from the sixth shared hour onward.
Do not exclude a single gaseous pollutant solely for a long zero run, because resolution and detection limits are not established.
flag_only_rules: Zero runs from six hours; positive exact flatlines from twelve hours.
Hampel deviation from the previous 24 hours (at least 12 observations), 6 scaled MAD, combined with a rate change above the training 99.5th percentile. Keep the flagged value.
PM10 disagreement with at least two contemporaneous neighbouring stations and persistent disagreement over a trailing 24-hour window. Keep the flagged value.
missingness: Inputs: forward fill at most two hours, then training station median with pooled training fallback. Preserve observed masks. Targets: never impute. Forecast origin must have observed retained PM10 and at least 18 observed PM10 values in the last 24 hours.
feature_engineering: Same 727 inputs for all three algorithms: 24 hours of eleven pollutant/weather variables, observation masks, independent QC flags, plus calendar, station, coordinates and PM10 summaries/changes.
leakage_control: Imputation, scaling and statistical thresholds fitted strictly before the inner validation boundary. Hard rules and all rolling features use current or prior measurements. Targets crossing a split boundary are purged. Fixed calendar boundaries in config.json; all sample cohorts generated afresh from independent retained measurements.
selection: MSE versus Huber and training duration selected on inner validation. Refit all chronological training rows. Four constrained ensembles fit on meta period; prediction intervals on calibration period. Test never used for new tuning.
evaluation: Same independently generated test station-hours for every model at a given horizon. RMSE, MAE, R2, bias, station/month detail and persistence reference. Seven-day paired bootstrap for conditional differences.
limits: QC rules are transparent heuristics, not certified instrument validation; sensitivity to zero-run thresholds has not been estimated.
A statistical flag can reflect genuine pollution. No percentile clipping, spike deletion or broad smoothing is applied.
Historical test period has previously been inspected; this is not a newly collected external holdout.
One fitted seed; operational availability of observations and archived weather is assumed rather than demonstrated.
